These risks make AI a uniquely challenging technology to deploy and utilize both for orga-nizations and within society. Without proper controls, AI systems can amplify, perpetuate, or exacerbate inequitable or undesirable outcomes for individuals and communities. With proper controls, AI systems can mitigate and manage inequitable outcomes. AI risk management is a key component of responsible development and use of AI sys-tems. Responsible AI practices can help align the decisions about AI system design, de-velopment, and uses with intended aim and values.
